metric_definitions.telemetry_arrival_delay_ms: One-way downlink delay: t_arrival_gcs − t_egress_uav (ms), matched by (system_id, time_boot_ms) or sequence. Diagnostic only.
metric_definitions.inter_arrival_gap_ms: Gap between consecutive LOCAL_POSITION_NED arrivals at GCS (ms).
metric_definitions.uav_to_gcs_delivery_ratio: ned_samples_gcs / ned_samples_uav (5G downlink delivery of NED).
